Title: Wrist Tingling? 3 Habits Behind Carpal Tunnel Syndrome

Description:
That tingling, aching pain in your wrist and fingers happens when the tunnel around your median nerve gets squeezed. Holding your phone with a bent wrist, typing without wrist support, and sleeping with your wrist curled are three everyday habits that make it worse - here's how to fix each one.

Ever wake up with your hand numb and tingling? 🖐️

Carpal tunnel syndrome happens when the tunnel around your median nerve gets squeezed - and your phone, keyboard, and sleep position could all be adding to the pressure. Straighten your wrist, add a wrist rest, and try a splint at night to ease it.
